recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not restore the original invariant or narrow onBehalfOf back to Organization; any future cleanup of generated diagram text should be handled under the later onBehalfOf broadening issues or build tooling.
issue_request: FHIR-12647 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue raised against DSTU2 CareTeam. It requested adding CareTeam.participant.practitionerOrganization as Reference(Organization) plus an invariant allowing it only when CareTeam.participant.member is a Practitioner; the approved modification renamed the element to onBehalfOf.
initial_application: The request was applied in two 2017 source commits: fd96fa1d8151 added CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf as Reference(Organization), and 9beeccb22219 added the CareTeam.participant invariant after the FHIR-12707/FHIRPath engine issue was resolved.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml is current build input. Later final decisions changed the original semantics: FHIR-29730 kept onBehalfOf but moved away from the Practitioner/Organization-only framing, FHIR-42928 broadened targets, updated the definition, and removed ctm-1, and FHIR-48432/FHIR-51595 later added Group and HealthcareService targets.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition has CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf, uses the broader proxy/agent/representative definition, includes Organization plus later approved target profiles, and has the original ctm-1 invariant commented out rather than active.

related_jiras.note: FHIRPath engine issue that unblocked the original ctm-1 invariant application.
No-change decision that kept CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf while recording that its semantics should not be limited to the original Practitioner/Organization use case.
Later Applied issue broadened CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf targets, updated its definition, and removed the original invariant.
Later Applied issue added Group to CareTeam.participant.member and onBehalfOf.
Later Applied issue added HealthcareService to CareTeam.participant.member and onBehalfOf.
